flat_title: How Manasa Fixed Her Writing and Got Band 8 Overall for Her Masters.
title: How Manasa Fixed Her Writing and Got Band 8 Overall for Her Masters.
description: Manasa had been learning English her whole life, so she thought IELTS would be straightforward. It wasn't. She scored Band 5 in Writing and 6.5 in Speaking. Then she found IELTS Advantage on YouTube and immediately understood what her preparation had been missing. She went back, followed the method, and retook the exam. She scored 9 in Listening, 8 in Reading, 7.5 in Speaking, and 7 in Writing. A complete turnaround. See how the right method helped her finally get the score she needed for her Masters abroad.
